title: Tooling: 1.50x faster P111 RUP checking with identical full replay
body:
This opt-in tooling package replaces assignment dictionaries with signed epoch storage in Gareth Davidson's PR1097 ordered RUP checker. Seven alternating pairs on the same pinned proofs measured **1.50x checker speedup** for the large c9 trace and **1.067x full fresh-process replay speedup** on macOS/CPython 3.14.7. Full runs retain formula regeneration, the original PR620 encoder comparison, positive calibration, parsing, every deduction and hint, inherited controls, and complete expected-receipt equality. Filesystem caches are warm; raw measurements and implementation hashes are in `BENCHMARK.json`.

**Status: verification tooling; no new kappa or multiplication-runtime claim.** Only `research/p111-rup-epochs-seed91/` is added. Frozen sources, `upstream/`, selected frontier and historical evidence remain unchanged.

Validation:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/p111-rup-epochs-seed91/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS`, 37,044 proof additions, 1,409,475 checked hints, 272,759 differential/independent-oracle cases, 12,277 truth-table entailment checks and 12 packaging negative controls. The complete canonical PR1097 receipt remains `ab65ab6dba482fb9c9741f7ff10235c972ed03052197ea1795374fd539a67d84`. Relocation, equivalent gzip recompression, preloaded-module rejection and a calibrated poisoned-bytecode control also pass under isolated optimized Python. The loader executes authenticated source bytes, rather than unchecked cached imports. This finite implementation audit is not a formal proof of the checker or multiplication theorem; selected frontier and native LRAT replays were not rerun.

Base: `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`. PR1097 reviewed dependency: `ad0cc538d7f827461da6364c3c0e09176b10bcae`; its complete source inventory and decoded proof payloads are pinned. The raw checker keeps the predecessor's parsed-proof/valid-original-literal contract and uses O(variables) dense storage. Full inherited source-order and physical/all-size/analytic limitations remain explicit.

Seed 91 assigns verification engineering. `CLAIM.json` records three narrow candidates, the local claim, bounded scope and refreshed overlap checks through #1186. No pinned coordination issue existed; the three discussion threads were checked. Concurrent #1184 targets emitted rational matrix auditing, not these propositional proof traces. Related #1059/#1092/#1099/#1137/#1144/#1151 are credited without combining performance claims.

Contributor: Philipp (@mightyOil), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and scoped AI reviews. Primary credit: Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), PR1097; Joel Pulikkan (@GamingPuzzled), PR620; the DreamingOfClouds geometry lineage; and the full predecessor notices including LRAT/DRAT-trim contributors. Apache-2.0; existing source licenses retained. No independent human review or Linux CI result is claimed.
